rule_name: Prior authorization required before high-cost procedure
good_example: Claim for CPT-93306 (Echocardiogram) with prior authorization on file → approved without delay
bad_example: Claim for CPT-93306 (Echocardiogram) without prior authorization → denied or escalated for review

good_example: Claim includes clinical notes showing symptoms
column7: Claim submitted without clinical documentation supporting medical necessity → denied or escalated

rule_name: Coverage must match member's plan version on service date
good_example: Claim from 2026 matched against 2025 Gold PPO booklet (effective 2025-01-01) → correct coverage applied
bad_example: Claim from 2024 matched against 2026 Gold PPO booklet → wrong coverage rules applied

rule_name: State-mandated benefits override national plan terms
good_example: California member receiving state-mandated autism therapy → covered per CA mandate
bad_example: California member denied autism therapy based only on national plan terms → compliance violation

column6: 000 flagged for additional review before payment → correct
column8: 000 paid without additional review → potential improper payment

rule_name: Medicare is secondary when member has active employer coverage
good_example: Claim for member with active employer plan → employer plan pays primary
column6: Claim for member with active employer plan → Medicare pays primary → incorrect coordination of benefits

rule_name: Denial reason code must match line status
good_example: Line with line_status = Denied includes denial_reason_code = CO-10 → correct
bad_example: Line with line_status = Approved includes denial_reason_code = CO-10 → invalid

rule_name: Grain must be preserved when joining claims to service lines
good_example: Claim CLM-10058 joined to 3 service lines → total remains $1
column6: Claim CLM-10058 joined to 3 service lines without grain declaration → total inflated to $3
